definitions.explanation: A person who works for a company.

examples.japanese: {会社員|かいしゃいん}として{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: To work as a company employee.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}の{会社員|かいしゃいん}です。
{会社員|かいしゃいん}の{生活|せいかつ}。

notes:
{会社員|かいしゃいん} combines {会社|かいしゃ} (company) + {員|いん} (member).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {会社員|かいしゃいん}として{働|はたら}く (work as a company employee)
- {普通|ふつう}の{会社員|かいしゃいん} (ordinary office worker)

RELATED TERMS:
- サラリーマン: salaryman (male office worker, casual)
- OL (オーエル): office lady (female office worker)
- {社員|しゃいん}: company employee (more internal perspective)
- {公務員|こうむいん}: government employee

Note: Common answer when asked about occupation ({職業|しょくぎょう}は{何|なん}ですか).
